title: The system fails to properly enforce scope authorization when the authorize_all_scopes configuration… (CVE-2025-11229)
description: CVE-2025-11229 is a vulnerability where the system does not properly enforce scope authorization when the 'authorize_all_scopes' configuration is enabled. This misconfiguration allows applications using the client credentials grant type to obtain all API scopes, including sensitive internal and console scopes, without explicit authorization. Exploitation can lead to privilege escalation, unauthorized administrative actions, access to confidential data, and potential full account takeover in affected deployments.
